inputs.text: Cuba appears to be heading toward some kind of political transition. Some Cubans fear that residents own nothing and are too poor to take over the few businesses still operating on the island, while the wealthy, sizable diaspora—and possibly foreign investors—could swoop in and buy property and businesses at bargain prices.
